decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0830   to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0830  to 1300  on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The basement car park hereby approved shall not be occupied until details of car parking (including motor cycle parking) and covered and secure cycle parking provision for parking zones 1, 2, 3, 4, 5c and 6 shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details shall identify and describe the location - physical as well as managerial (including means of access thereto; widths and gradients of ramps; location, type and operation of barriers to and within basement car parking; circulation space; lighting; CCTV; arrangements for ventilation of basement car parking (including details of sound attenuation for any necessary mechanical plants and the standard of dilution expected); and internal treatment of basement car parking (including the location, type and appearance of all the directional signage in the car park for pedestrians to the lifts)
Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained in full working order thereafter.
(i) No more than the approved number of car parking spaces shall be provided on or under the site for the development hereby permitted
and such spaces shall be permanently available and not used for any other purpose than as approved.
(ii)The cycle parking spaces shall be permanently available for the parking of cycles and not be used for any other purpose. The details submitted should be set out in accordance with the approved Car Park Management Plan.

Condition : 5 - Before 17 August 2011 or the occupation of Building B (irrespective of whether Building B is built as standard approved under planning permission 00505/P/P59 or planning permission 00505/P/P74), whichever is the
earlier, details of:(a) the vehicle access points from Ealing Road, Clayponds Lane and the service road parallel to the Great West Road; (b) sightlines at
points of access to the public highway; and(c) the kerb line alteration of the egress onto the Great West Road shall have been i) submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority; and (ii) the approved works carried out.

Condition : 6 - The basement car park hereby approved shall not be occupied until details of the proposed pay and display car park have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Detail shall include schedule of charges and hours of operations. Approved details shall then be implemented
description: Changes to the layout of the 1,045 car parking spaces and 600 cycle spaces already approved under planning permission reference 00505/P/P59 dated 8 December 2006; details of the bus standing space(s) and bus stop(s) required off the central 'piazza' under planning permission 00505/P/P59; and additional (new) basement parking in the northwest corner of the site to provide 62 car parking spaces for commercial land uses and 150 cycle spaces.  In addition, a further 17 car spaces are proposed for the additional residential units proposed in application reference 00505/P/P73 and a further 7 car spaces are proposed for the additional hotel bedrooms proposed in application reference 00505/P/P74.
